name: [INVITES] Fix It Up!
desc:
🔧 Welcome to Fix It Up!
Step into the garage and turn rusty junk into profit!

🚗 Buy wrecked cars, repair every part, upgrade, paint, and sell for cash.
🧠 Got car knowledge? Great — you'll need it! This game gets technical.

Featuring:
🔥 Realistic mechanic gameplay with detailed parts.
🎨 Customization, painting, and upgrades.
💰 Profit system — fix smart, sell high!
🛠️ Tools, machines, and workbenches to get the job done.

👨‍🔧 Built for car lovers and gearheads — but anyone can learn!

Start fixing and flipping now! 🏁
